task: Add EDNS padding (RFC 7830) to messages. Message.use_edns() and dns.message.make_query() get a new keyword pad, a non-negative int, default 0. When pad is non-zero, to_wire() must add an EDNS PADDING option of zero bytes so that the total wire length is an exact multiple of pad. The option is always added when pad is non-zero, even if it ends up empty, and pad=0 changes nothing. The length must count everything in the final message: the OPT record with its existing options, the 4 byte header of the padding option, and any TSIG record added after the OPT, including when TSIG is signed. Expected lengths for make_query("www.example", "a", use_edns=0): 40 with no padding, then pad=1 gives 44, pad=2 gives 44, pad=3 gives 45, pad=44 gives 44, pad=67 gives 67 and pad=128 gives 128. With options=[dns.edns.ECSOption("1.2.3.0", 24)] and pad=128 the length is 128, and after q.use_tsig(keyring) with a default algorithm key from dns.tsigkeyring.from_text({"keyname.": "NjHwPsMKjdN++dOfE5iAiQ=="}) it is 256. dns.message.from_wire must parse every result back to a message equal to the original, and the TSIG must verify with keyring=keyring. Add Renderer.reserve(size) and Renderer.release_reserved(), which hold room back and give it back: on a Renderer with max_size=512, reserve(100) makes max_size 412 and release_reserved() restores 512, and reserve raises ValueError for a negative size or one larger than max_size.
